title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
翌日清晨。种植园内。“水流太急了，慢一点慢一点，不要把我的地都给冲坏了！”“水枪是你前期最基本的攻击技能，连这个都把握不好，还怎么对战？”林枫和藤藤蛇则是坐在桃桃果树的树荫下，一个指导着杰尼龟，另一个则是伸长着藤鞭，不停的在杰尼龟的脚附近拍打着。为了躲避藤鞭，杰尼龟只能不断换着地方喷水，一脸的怨气。大早上，自己的训练家，就跟它说，给自己找了一个好老师。准教准会的那种。抱着好奇的心理，杰尼龟同意了这个要求。在见到是昨天的那个人类后，它本来还挺高兴的。可现在....它心中对林枫的怨气到达了巅峰。这哪是让自己来练习水枪？这不就是让自己来帮他灌水？没水了，真的，一滴都没了....刚刚灌溉好一片地，杰尼龟的脸颊都有些凹陷的痕迹了。“好了，过来休息一下吧。”一直用【探查之眼】查看着杰尼龟状态的林枫适时的让它过来休息一会。藤藤蛇的鞭子也停了下来。杰尼龟怨气满满的凑了过来。【精灵：杰尼龟】【性别：雌】【特性：激流】【资质：蓝色】【个体值：HP（18）攻击（20）特攻（21）防御（25）特防（24）速度（16）】【实力：6~8级】【技能：撞击，摇尾巴，水枪，缩入壳中】【介绍：它不想干活了！！

】【亲密度：-20（它觉得你比它的训练家更坏。）】【愉悦值：-25（怨气满满的早起龟。）】“来，吃能量方块。”林枫拿出了自己制造的恢复体力能量方块。这是用昨天买回来的树果制造而成的。【c级能量方块——由文柚果配合清幽山泉制造而成的能量方块，服用后，能在极短的时间内恢复体力，长期服用，还能提升宝可梦的体力值。料理效果：服用后，增强宝可梦对招式的领悟能力。】很简短的介绍。但涉及到长期服用，能永久提升宝可梦某项能力值的能量方块，在这个世界上，可是珍贵的很。一般有钱都买不到。但林枫并不会直接将这能量方块的价值告诉杰尼龟。而是选择循循善诱，“来，吃一块？”“杰尼....”满口怨气的喊了一声，早就饿瘪了的杰尼龟接过能量方块，然后一口咬下。刹那间，清澈温润的感觉在口腔中迸发出来，杰尼龟的眼睛顿时就亮了起来，狼吞虎咽吃下后，原本无神的卡姿兰大眼睛中，顿时就有了光彩。“没事，能量方块管够。”面对自己招募的“员工”林枫自然不会吝啬。反正它能吃下多少，就给多少。【恭喜宿主让杰尼龟的愉悦值从-20%提升到30%，奖励金坷垃二十袋，神奇糖果三枚，清澈的水流一份（能让水系宝可梦的水流更加纯粹，使用水系技能更加熟练。）】终于...一块也吃不下的杰尼龟毫无形象的躺在了地上，脸上露出了满意的神色。林枫也没有选择第一时间“压榨”它，而是静静的在原地看着，嘴角露出了笑容。这样熟悉的一幕。
content_en:
The next morning.Inside the plantation."The water flow is too fast. Slow down, don't destroy all my land!" "Water gun is your most basic attack skill in the early stage. How can you fight if you can't master this well?" Lin Feng and Vine Snake were sitting in the shade of the peach fruit tree. One was guiding Squirtle, and the other was stretching his vine whip and constantly slapping Squirtle's feet.In order to avoid the vine whip, Squirtle could only keep spraying water from different places, with a look of resentment on his face.Early in the morning, his trainer told it that he had found a good teacher for him.The kind that would be a quasi-teacher.Out of curiosity, Squirtle agreed to this request.After seeing the human being from yesterday, it was quite happy.But now... the resentment in its heart towards Lin Feng has reached its peak.How can I let myself practice water gun?Isn't this just asking yourself to help him fill the water?There is no water, really, not a drop... Just after irrigating a field, Squirtle's cheeks have some sunken marks."Okay, come here and take a rest." Lin Feng, who had been checking Squirtle's status with [Exploratory Eyes], asked him to come over and take a rest at the right time.Vine Snake's whip also stopped.Squirtle came over full of resentment.[Elf: Squirtle] [Gender: Female] [Characteristics: Riptide] [Qualification: Blue] [Individual Value: HP (18) Attack (20) Special Attack (21) Defense (25) Special Defense (24) Speed ​​(16)] [Strength: Level 6~8] [Skills: Impact, tail wagging, water gun, retracting into the shell] [Introduction: It doesn’t want to work anymore!!

] [Friendship: -20 (It thinks you are worse than its trainer.)] [Pleasure value: -25 (a resentful morning turtle.)] "Here, eat energy cubes." Lin Feng took out the energy cubes he made to restore physical strength.This is made from the fruit I bought yesterday.[C-level energy cube - an energy cube made from pomelo fruit and quiet mountain springs. After taking it, it can restore physical strength in a very short time. Long-term use can also increase the physical strength of Pokémon.Cooking effect: After taking it, it will enhance Pokémon’s ability to understand moves.】A very brief introduction.But when it comes to long-term use, energy cubes that can permanently improve a certain ability value of a Pokémon are very precious in this world.Generally, money can’t buy it.But Lin Feng would not directly tell Squirtle the value of this energy cube.Instead, he chose to follow the temptation and asked, "Here, eat a piece?" "Squirtle..." He shouted with resentment. Squirtle, who was already hungry, took the energy cube and took a bite.In an instant, a clear and warm feeling burst out in the mouth, and Squirtle's eyes suddenly lit up. After devouring it, Kazilan's big eyes, which were originally dull, suddenly became bright."It's okay, the energy cubes are enough." Lin Feng naturally wouldn't be stingy when it came to the "employees" he recruited.Anyway, give it as much as it can eat.[Congratulations to the host for increasing Squirtle's pleasure value from -20% to 30%. As a reward, he will be rewarded with twenty bags of golden rubbish, three magical candies, and a portion of clear water (which can make the water flow of water Pokémon more pure and make the use of water skills more proficient.)] Finally... Squirtle, who couldn't eat a piece, lay on the ground without any image, with a look of satisfaction on his face.Lin Feng did not choose to "squeeze" it immediately, but watched quietly on the spot, with a smile on his lips.Such a familiar scene.
